visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a white cardigan over a black camisole, sits at a wooden table in a brightly lit indoor space. She laughs intensely, throwing her head back and clapping her hands. A small glass of brown liquid is visible on the table. (2) The scene cuts to the same woman leaning her head on her hand, looking down at a smartphone on the table. Her expression is bored and unimpressed. (3) She covers her face with both hands, mimicking a crying gesture with exaggerated movements. (4) She sits upright again, looking into the camera while adjusting her hair and touching her eye area as if checking her makeup. (5) The woman begins fanning herself with her hands, looking distressed by the heat. She pulls at the shoulders of her white cardigan, revealing her black top beneath. (6) She removes the white cardigan entirely, looking directly at the camera with a pained expression while holding her phone. (7) She fans herself vigorously with a white tissue, looking irritated and sweaty, with pieces of paper scattered on the table in front of her.
